title: README advertises a database-row setting that has no implementation
claim: DD_IAST_DB_ROWS_TO_TAINT is documented as tainting database rows, but production code only parses it and the parent plan says row taint is deferred.

title: Runtime configuration omits the enforced vulnerability ceiling
claim: The README permits every integer >=1 for DD_IAST_VULNERABILITIES_PER_REQUEST, while code clamps values to the undocumented hard range 1..64.

title: Completed plans remain and the phase record is internally contradictory
claim: Eleven plan artifacts remain despite AGENTS.md deletion policy; phase 7a still says draft although the parent says all implementation phases are complete.

title: Finder metadata is committed at repository root
claim: The root .DS_Store is tracked, while _docs/.DS_Store is neither tracked nor present.

title: Removing the sources-and-sinks directory discarded useful future-integration research
claim: The 1,131-line deleted framework catalog contained reusable source, sink, binder, and zero-copy lifetime research with no maintained in-tree successor.
